title: Confirming Activate moves the ticked parts back to the Active tab
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [User-A], signed in with the Admin role. Admin holds the 'Part Library & Inventory' permissions View, Create & Edit and Delete by default (Settings → Roles & Permissions); Delete is what allows Deactivate parts and Activate parts.
  • Location: [Loc-1], any one location [User-A] can pick in the location selector in the top bar.
  • Browser: a desktop browser window at least 1280 pixels wide (parts management is desktop and tablet only).
  • Data: at [Loc-1], 3 inactive parts [Part-A], [Part-B] and [Part-C], part numbers ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REACT-01 to -03 (examples).

Setup

  1. Sign in as [User-A] and pick [Loc-1] in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. Create [Part-A]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL react A" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REACT-01 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-A] = the part number you typed.
  3. Create [Part-B]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL react B" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REACT-02 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-B] = the part number you typed.
  4. Create [Part-C]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL react C" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REACT-03 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-C] = the part number you typed.
  5. Make [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab type [Part-A] in the Search box, click its row, pick Part Status → Inactive in Edit Inventory Part, click Save, then click Deactivate in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation (leave Note (Optional) empty).
  6. Make [Part-B] inactive: on the Active tab type [Part-B] in the Search box, click its row, pick Part Status → Inactive in Edit Inventory Part, click Save, then click Deactivate in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation (leave Note (Optional) empty).
  7. Make [Part-C] inactive: on the Active tab type [Part-C] in the Search box, click its row, pick Part Status → Inactive in Edit Inventory Part, click Save, then click Deactivate in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation (leave Note (Optional) empty).
  8. Check the setup worked: the Inactive tab searched for ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REACT lists [Part-A], [Part-B] and [Part-C].
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Click the Inactive tab.
  3. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REACT in the Search box.
  4. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar (to the left of New Inventory Part).
  5. Click Activate parts.
  6. Click the [Part-A] row.
  7. Click the [Part-B] row.
  8. Click the Activate button on the bar.
  9. Click Activate in the "Activate parts?" confirmation.
  10. Click the Active tab.
  11. If the Search box is empty, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REACT in it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 8: The "Activate parts?" confirmation opens, reads "2 parts selected.", and its confirm button is a blue "Activate".
  • Step 9: A green toast reads "2 parts updated." [Part-A] and [Part-B] leave the Inactive list at once, without a page reload; [Part-C] is still listed. Bulk mode ends and nothing is ticked.
  • Step 11: The Active tab lists [Part-A] and [Part-B] (and not [Part-C]).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10816 (Story 3, Activate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S3-R4, S3-R5, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.6 (Inactive tab, Activate parts), board 4.7 (Confirm the reactivation). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R4: “When the user confirms (Story 10), every ticked part becomes active and leaves the Inactive tab without a page reload.”
  • S3-R5: “The reactivated parts appear on the Active tab.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Bulk change, every part changed): “"{n} parts updated." ("1 part updated." for one)”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Bulk change, every part changed): “Success toast, fades on its own”
